entry_points.text: Build tool: expects one ELF path, maps and validates it, emits hypervisor entries from relocation sections, exits nonzero on misuse or bad format.

Host exit saves/restores registers around trap handling; companion resumes restore only. Vector routes host sync to handling. HVC exits or stubs, protected always exits. SMC reloads regs, calls once, writes back.

Panic sets masked host return with syndrome/addresses, optional stage-2 off. Init diverts low IDs, checks ID. CPU entries verify level, enable translation/vectors. Stub: restart, reset, error. Switch replaces base/stack.

Run resolves host/hypervisor CPUs, checks streaming quiescence when protected, flushes/runs/syncs or runs host direct. Sync only loaded non-protected. Donate takes two frames, needs loaded protected plus refill.

exports.text: FF-A gate and probe. Gate filters IDs, allows only version pre-negotiation, dispatches memory/partition ops, passes through rest if supported. Probe clamps minor, splits pages into Tx/Rx/descriptor.
Protected vCPU load, unload, current query, VM resolve. Load maps handle/index to hypervisor vCPU; put releases; query returns calling-CPU resident; resolve needs table lock.
Guest execution for non-VHE and host-extensions modes. Each takes a vCPU and returns an exit reason for host handling.
State and protected-memory helpers: non-VHE save/restore, VHE shared plus return, timer traps, cache refill, single-page donation.

hazards.text: Share checks firmware offsets, releases channel on early fail, maps failures distinctly; reclaim fail terminal, post-reclaim unshare warns. Partition busy sans storage, aborts on overflow.

Panic tolerates missing host context; non-restoring path must not touch registers. Translation needs invalidate plus barriers; key swaps need ordering. Loads need table lock vs partial publish or dying resurrection.
Protected 32-bit guest forced invalid: init mark cleared, async-error kept, illegal forced. Protected run with streaming active rejected before flush/execute.
Mitigated parts install guest address controls only after stage-2 on with barriers; teardown reverses exactly. Entry raises priority mask with sync so host wakeup survives; exit lowers.

invariants.text: Support denies retrieve/relinq/pause/resume/frag-Rx/donate/poll/wait/narrow-alias/notify/newer IDs. Share/lend queries OK w/o dyn buffers. Post probe checks host ID, wide-map, buffer codes. Partition forwards ID/flags, count-only aware, bounds copies.

Loader checks size, magic, 64-bit class, endianness, relocatable AArch64 type, section table/names; rejects zero offsets, bad indices. Emission visits only addend relocs, rejects old-style, skips non-hyp, checks offsets, emits ABS64 only.
Handles subtract a base; out-of-range and reserved rejected. Query returns calling-CPU resident.
Vectors move under per-side maxima, length control on side moved. Sync only when guest owns. Irq clamps count to capacity, copies that many, fixes enables, preserves control.

Bulk moves registers, saved status, FP, most sysregs; timer left to host. Flush clears running, copies debug/irq/syndrome, merges host-owned bits. Sync always returns fault/irq; protected returns whole context.

Debug follows ownership: guest moves breakpoints/watchpoints both ways, host moves external state, else marker only. Protected load propagates wait-trap; others refresh fine-grained traps; clean unload writes back first.
Exit uses protected table for protected CPUs, standard otherwise, chosen fresh per exit.
Non-VHE covers first-level, shared, user, return. Timer restore allows phys timer/counter; guest denies timer, allows counter if protected or zero offset, traps virtual on broken offsets.

Activation merges controls, reloads direct timer on mapping, traps on, guest vectors. Compute forces nesting bits, publishes view. Deactivation restores flags/timer. Fixup syncs views, shared repair decides retry.

Refill meets minimum hyp pages by admitting host pages, consuming a working copy, writing back rest. Donation checks host-owned source, empty guest slot, encodes ownership, maps one owned page full perms.
Uses external warning, copy, barrier and per-CPU helpers owned elsewhere.

locks.text: Version lock guards negotiation and completion flag. Mailbox lock guards share completion and partition query across checks, copies, firmware calls.
One spin lock covers table lookup, lifecycle checks, slot publication, residency flags and refcounts across load/unload.
Donation takes host ownership then guest ownership, holds both across validation and mapping, releases in reverse including early failures.

state_machines.text: Version starts unnegotiated, rejects major mismatch, adopts downgrade on firmware accept, publishes completion ordered. Dispatch gates to version, then fixed ops or pass-through. Share stages, pulls fragments, validates, reclaims, releases.
CPU init: level check, exception setup, translation on, vectors installed, host return. Lower-level cores wait forever.
Residency: unloaded, loaded active, released; load fails if CPU busy or target held elsewhere; put drops pin. FP: flush claims host w/o move; sync moves only from guest then claims host.
Non-VHE: capture host, install guest, re-enter while repair asks retry, restore host. Trap on saves host debug, installs guest traps/vectors; off reverses.
VHE masks interrupts around inner run. Inner: FP in, capture host, traps on, install guest, repeat on retry, capture guest, traps off, restore host, FP out.

structs.text: ELF view: path, base, size, header/section-table pointers, name storage. Helpers resolve pointers by offset, sections by index/offset, endian-correct.
Naming: prefix dot-hyp, container dot-hyp-dot-reloc, symbols __hyp_section_. Two variants encode ELF fields little vs big endian.
Reloc IDs: ABS64 257, ABS32 258, PREL64 260, PREL32 261, PREL16 262, PLT32 314. Only ABS64 emits; rest permitted silently.
Init block: stack, attributes, controls, bases. vCPU: registers, saved status, FP, sysregs, irq, debug, traps, lifecycle. Hyp vCPU embeds a vCPU, links to host for cache pairing.
Handles index a bounded table with reserved sentinel; low IDs stubbed. Host context holds ordered registers. Hypercall operands use fixed slots. Forced invalid exit keeps async-error, forces illegal.
